# Chapter 1: The Shock

The cabin sat where the pines met the sand, somewhere along the edge of northern Michigan where the trees grew thick enough to make shadows and the lake was cold enough to take your breath away. It was the summer of 1958, and Bob was six years old, and the world was still a place where a boy could disappear into the woods for hours and no one would come looking.
